errors.text_span: През 2016 г. стойността започва да се увеличава, достига около 1,25%
errors.evidence: The description states that the value for 2016 is approximately 1.25%. However, the chart shows the value for 2016 is clearly below the 1.00% line, at approximately 0.7%. The value of 1.25% corresponds to the year 2013.
